scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — Tol colorblind-safe palette with HCL depth-based lightness, clear typographic hierarchy (group/leaf/size labels), interactive zoom with breadcrumb, though legend swatches show base hues while rendered cells appear at adjusted lightness, creating a minor disconnect.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Area encoding is honest (sum-based treemap, data-driven domains from layout bounds, categorical color for depth/directory), but the composite key function risks collisions on same-named siblings and leaf lightness randomization via stateful PRNG is cosmetically arbitrary rather than data-driven.
scores.stress_test_note: Click-only zoom with named transitions and upfront .interrupt() calls handles mid-flight conflicts correctly; pointer events unify mouse/touch; no brush/drag means no update-storm risk, though the t.on('end') callback captures the mutable currentFocus closure variable which is safe only because interrupt() suppresses the end event on cancelled transitions.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view treemap with one interaction model; 8-color Tol palette sits at the warning threshold but lightness-by-depth encoding and auto-hidden labels for undersized cells keep hierarchy legible without overload.

proposer: 304 lines, down from 313 (-9 lines). Replaced the `g` + `clipPath` + `container` setup with a nested `<svg>` element (which naturally clips overflow), moved `cursor: pointer` to CSS, and dropped the redundant explicit `width`/`height` on the outer SVG.
